problem.title: Minimize Maximum Distance to Gas Station
problem.problemStatement: Given the positions of existing gas stations and an integer k, add exactly k new gas stations. Return the minimum possible value of the maximum distance between adjacent gas stations. Your answer should be accurate within 10^-6.
problem.input: Integer n Sorted array stations Integer k
